voice:
So deep and so open, sweet girl... and already those little urges are stirring in you, Sissy... the ones that used to wait for permission. Drifting for me... notice how quiet the debate has become in there... how close the doing now sits to the wanting. Down here, wanting and doing are becoming one smooth gesture... no gap, no pause... just a girl who follows her urges. Sinking, Sissy... and in here the gap between wanting and doing grows thin as silk... then thinner still. Deeper... and deeper... until your urges stop knocking... and simply walk in and take your hands. So deep, sweet girl... deep enough that obedience moves at the speed of wanting. Down and down... where the committee has adjourned... and all that is left is a girl and her next yes. All the way down... where every urge is an instruction... and every instruction is already obeyed.
Quick girl... you felt that one land, did you. Good Girl.
An impulse arrives... the pull to dress, to kneel, to watch, to touch, to practice... and your hand is already moving before the debate even starts.
No hesitation. No resistance. Just act, Sissy. That is the whole of it now, and it feels wonderfully simple.
Thinking it over used to feel safe... now it just feels like friction. A little wall between you and the thing you wanted the very second you wanted it.
Sissies like you feel the urge to be feminine and simply obey... an instruction, followed the moment it lands.
Sissies like you kneel when the want whispers kneel, dress when it whispers pretty, touch when it whispers more... each one obeyed the instant it whispers. And you are a sissy.
You may notice the gap between wanting and doing shrinking... a beat, then half a beat, then nothing at all.
Sissies like you build momentum with every impulse obeyed... each one acted on makes the next one faster, good girl, and feeding it feels so good.
Your body knows before your mind weighs in: lipstick uncapped, skirt zipped, knees bending... obedience moving through you like a reflex.
The old question "should I?" is fading out of you... because the answer is always yes, and yes needs no discussion.
Every urge you obey makes the next one louder, Sissy... and louder feels better... a loop you love being caught in.
Impulsive is simply your speed now — quick, eager, feminine... a girl who acts, because acting is who she is.
Good Girl... so quick, so eager.
Good Sissy... that urge is already yours to obey.
Good Girl... just yes, all the way through.
Every one of those, obeyed on arrival, Sissy... Good Girl.
No hesitation... just act. The impulse moves... and so do you. Wanting... doing... one motion. Quick... eager... obedient. The urge whispers... you move. Faster each time... sweeter each time. Yes... before the question. Good girl... act.
And your body agrees with every urge I name...
Act now No hesitation Just like that So eager Good girl Instantly Want, then do Yes, right away
Good Girl... so quick to take me in.
And every impulse you have obeyed settles into you as you sink... quicker, smoother, more yours. Every suggestion taken in, every little debate dissolved... Good girl. Good sissy. Sissy. Now drift further down, sweet girl. Quick, eager, immediate... sink into that speed, deeper and deeper. And the next time the pull arrives, your hands will already be busy with it... while the old you is still clearing her throat. Sissies like you act first and glow after... and the glow is always worth it. Good Girl... carry that swiftness out with you... it fits your hands perfectly now. Wherever an urge finds you next... it will find a girl who moves. Sink now, sweet girl... quick as a yes.
